findings_qualitative.value: CO(3-2) and CO(4-3) detected for the first time in a jet-gas interaction region; HCN, HCO+ and [CI] not detected

evidence.quote: The $^{12}$CO(3-2) and $^{12}$CO(4-3) were detected for the first time in a region of radio jet-gas interaction

claims.hypothesis: Gas in the Horseshoe complex is described by a given temperature and density
claims.experiment: RADEX LVG grid against CO line ratios relative to ALMA+ACA CO(1-0)
claims.result: T_kin 55-70 K, n_H 2-6e2 cm^-3, degenerate solution
claims.finding: Higher-J CO is not strongly excited, SLED peaks at Jup~2-3

evidence.quote: A grid of models predicts a kinetic temperature of $55-70\: K$ and densities between $2-6\times 10^2\: cm^{-3}$.

claims.hypothesis: Low-velocity shocks can explain the CO emission
claims.result: Best models n_H=100 cm^-3, G0=0, low velocity, poorly constrained

evidence.quote: This grid tends to indicate that the pre-shock density is of the order of $100\: cm^{-3}$

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: J-type shocks rejected: absolute intensities too low

evidence.quote: J-type models produce absolute integrated intensities that are too low compared with observed values

limitations_admitted.value: Models poorly constrained; degeneracy among n, N, T; single pointing and different beams may bias ratios

evidence.loc: 4.1 Low-velocity gradient modelling of the CO emission
